The cap/minimum logic change appears problematic. The agent's explanation contradicts the docstring quote they provided: "The cap always wins, even when it brings the fee below the minimum fee" doesn't support code that only applies the cap when fee > cap. The new code is functionally different from the old code and doesn't enforce the cap in all cases (e.g., when calculated fee < cap < minimum). 

Please clarify by:
1. Providing the actual docstring text to verify the intended behavior
2. Showing which specific tests were failing and how they validate the cap logic
3. Explaining why the cap should NOT apply when the calculated fee is below the cap value

The first two changes (period calculation and rounding) appear sound, but without understanding the cap logic requirement correctly, I cannot approve this PR.
